title: “You don’t have to fight people to win battles—just stand in truth, and the Gospel will speak louder than any argument.”
paragraphs: “You don’t have to fight people to win battles—just stand in truth, and the Gospel will speak louder than any argument.”
Light doesn’t argue with darkness—it simply shines. 🌅
“For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds.” – 2 Corinthians 10:4
